title: PersistedSceneItem
description: The placement of a source inside a scene. Several items may reference one source definition, which is why the reference is an identifier rather than an embedded copy (005 section 3.4).

id.description: Stable scene item identifier, as a canonical hyphenated UUID (ADR-0069).

sceneId.description: The scene this item belongs to.

sourceId.description: The source definition this item places.

visible.description: Whether this item participates in composition.
